defect.problem: The parallel_cite includes a facially-impossible reporter entry: "92 L. Ed. 2d 436". Johnson was decided in 1948, but Lawyers' Edition Second Series (L. Ed. 2d) did not begin until 1956; volume 92 of L. Ed. 2d is a 1980s case. The correct first-series parallel "92 L. Ed. 436" is already listed, so the same volume/page (92 ... 436) is redundantly presented under two different reporter series — a data-parsing artifact carried from the lake cluster.citations[].
defect.proposed_fix: Drop "92 L. Ed. 2d 436" from parallel_cite, leaving "68 S. Ct. 367; 92 L. Ed. 436".

residual_risks: Artifact originates upstream in the CL cluster citations; fix is cosmetic to the cite list, not to case identity.
